name: the mark adopted as the room's emblem while it is still placed, damage included
what_it_changes: Within F11, the room takes the mark into its own sub (banner, flair, a room feature) during placement, and it may adopt the damaged form as fitting.
why: Cut rule R3: a level-3 child of F11's key, held by 5 or more of its members, whose lines (read in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-step_P13_T4-028.txt) state a narrower change than F11's. 'Adoption can occur during live placement and include correction of the image already installed on the subreddit' (pitt); 'Members revalue an unwanted final blemish as an emblem' (cgpgrey). These are the labelers' how sentences.
